metadata.description: Official spreadsheet automation libraries plus workbook security, accessibility, and cloud automation guidance.
metadata.title: Document XLSX - Sources

python_libraries.name: openpyxl Documentation
python_libraries.relevance: Python library for reading and editing .xlsx/.xlsm files, including tables, validation, protection, and workbook loading options. Current stable release is 3.1.5; see the Optimised Modes page for write_only/read_only streaming behavior on large files.

python_libraries.name: XlsxWriter Documentation
python_libraries.relevance: Write-focused Python library for table-first exports, formatting, formulas, charts, and polished report outputs. Write-only: cannot open or edit an existing workbook.

python_libraries.name: pandas.DataFrame.to_excel
python_libraries.relevance: DataFrame export reference for reproducible Excel outputs, engine selection, freeze panes, and styling workflows.

python_libraries.name: xlwings Documentation
python_libraries.relevance: Python-to-Excel automation when you need native Excel features on a machine with Excel installed.

python_libraries.name: calamine — GitHub
python_libraries.relevance: Fast pure-Rust reader for xls, xlsx, xlsb, and ods; zero ML/GPU dependency. Use directly via Python bindings (python-calamine) for high-performance spreadsheet ingestion in LLM and data pipelines.

python_libraries.name: Docling (IBM Research) — GitHub
python_libraries.relevance: Production document-extraction library (IBM Research) producing structured DoclingDocument from XLSX, PDF, DOCX, PPTX, HTML, and images. Primary source for releases, issue tracking, and integration examples.

python_libraries.name: Mistral OCR
python_libraries.relevance: OCR API understanding text, tables, equations, and embedded media across document formats; ~1000 pages per dollar. Relevant when Excel data is embedded in scanned or image-heavy documents. Docs at https://docs.mistral.ai/

nodejs_libraries.name: ExcelJS
nodejs_libraries.relevance: Node.js library for generating and editing .xlsx files with styles, formulas, tables, and workbook structure operations. Native chart generation is not supported; pivot-table support is experimental as of the 4.4.x/4.5.x line.

nodejs_libraries.name: SheetJS Documentation
nodejs_libraries.relevance: Spreadsheet ingestion and export across formats; useful for parsing, interoperability, and metadata-aware workbook handling.

nodejs_libraries.name: SheetJS Security Notes
nodejs_libraries.relevance: Security guidance for formula injection, hyperlinks, and workbook parsing risks in spreadsheet workflows.

cloud_automation.name: Office Scripts PivotTables
cloud_automation.relevance: Official Excel on the web automation reference for creating and manipulating native PivotTables with Office Scripts.

cloud_automation.name: Office Scripts Table Interface
cloud_automation.relevance: Reference for table operations in Office Scripts, including headers, totals, filters, and structured workbook automation.

cloud_automation.name: Microsoft Graph Excel Workbook API
cloud_automation.relevance: Remote workbook sessions and workbook object model for Microsoft 365-hosted Excel files.

accessibility_and_compliance.name: Accessibility Best Practices with Excel Spreadsheets
accessibility_and_compliance.relevance: Practical Microsoft guidance for descriptive worksheet names, accessible tables, meaningful links, and workbook checkers.

accessibility_and_compliance.name: Section 508 Accessible Spreadsheets
accessibility_and_compliance.relevance: US federal accessibility guidance for spreadsheets, including workbook structure, A1 context, and blank worksheet avoidance.

accessibility_and_compliance.name: ECMA-376 Office Open XML
accessibility_and_compliance.relevance: Underlying OOXML standard behind .xlsx; useful for interoperability edge cases and low-level workbook inspection.

accessibility_and_compliance.name: Microsoft Open Specifications for OOXML
accessibility_and_compliance.relevance: Stable entry point for Microsoft's published Office Open XML implementation notes and format details.
